response: 🎒 **FIFA World Cup 2026 Clear Bag Policy:** Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to **12" x 6" x 12"** are allowed. Small clutch bags (4.5" x 6.5") are also permitted. Large backpacks, luggage, and opaque bags are prohibited.

🎟️ **Ticketing & Gate Access:** All tickets are 100% digital via the Official FIFA Ticketing App. Screenshot tickets are NOT valid. Please add your pass to Apple Wallet or Google Pay before arriving to speed up entry.

🍟 **Food & Beverage:** You can order food directly to your seat or choose Express Counter Pickup using the **Services** tab on this app! Refillable empty plastic water bottles up to 20 oz are permitted at all water hydration stations.

♿ **Accessibility Services:** Wheelchair seating, audio-described commentary, and sensory relief rooms are available. Head to the **Accessibility** section to view step-by-step barrier-free navigation and elevator locations.

🚨 **Emergency & First Aid:** Medical stations are located at Section 128, 214, and 330. In an urgent emergency, click the **Red SOS Button** on the **Emergency** page or contact Stadium Security immediately at 911 / Direct Dispatch.
📶 **Stadium Free Wi-Fi:** Connect to network `FIFA2026_Stadium_FreeWiFi`. No password required. Accept the portal terms for high-speed match commentary streaming!
🚌 **Transportation & Parking:** Dedicated FIFA Fan Express shuttles run every 5 mins from central transit hubs. Ride-share drop-off zones are located at Lot E (North Plaza).
